evd_title: AI platforms drafted SOPs covering fundamental sections with variations across platforms
finding: AI platforms drafted SOPs covering fundamental sections with variations across platforms
P: 16 IRB SOP topics x 3 platforms = 48 SOP drafts; health research ethics/IRB
I: Poe Assistant, ChatGPT (GPT-3.5), Google Bard; topic-specific SOP drafting prompts
C: Mayo Clinic IRB Policy Manual and Harvard Longwood SOPs (reference); 2 author reviewers
O: Qualitative: all drafts covered 5 fundamental sections; platform differences on 7 of 16 topics; no score/IAA
S: Cross-sectional observational LLM evaluation (qualitative coverage assessment)
T: Not reported on page (reference SOPs 2023; paper 2024)
